Name: Moderna Inc
Description: Moderna, Inc. is a leading biotechnology company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, specializing in the development of messenger RNA (mRNA) technology for vaccine and therapeutic applications. Renowned for its pivotal role in combating infectious diseases, notably its COVID-19 vaccine, Moderna is expanding its portfolio to address a diverse range of health conditions, including immuno-oncology, rare diseases, cardiovascular diseases, and autoimmune disorders. With a strong focus on innovation and a robust pipeline, Moderna aims to transform the landscape of medicine through its groundbreaking mRNA platform.
Address: 325 BINNEY STREET, CAMBRIDGE, MA, UNITED STATES, 02142
